name: Bergen County, NJ
findings: Bergen County has 3,904 nonprofit organizations. 1,472 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,146 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Bergen County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
